import random
random.seed(7)
N=50000
miss_decl=0
miss_derived=0
for _ in range(N):
    a,b=random.sample(range(2000),2)
    true={a,b}
    claimed=set(true)
    if random.random()<0.30:
        claimed.remove(random.choice(tuple(claimed)))
    changed={random.choice(tuple(true))} if random.random()<0.5 else {random.randrange(2000)}
    conflict=bool(changed & true)
    if conflict and not (changed & claimed): miss_decl+=1
    derived={a,b}
    if conflict and not (changed & derived): miss_derived+=1
print({'n':N,'trusted_decl_miss_rate':miss_decl/N,'derived_misses':miss_derived})
